text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Thursday.
- The United States: There are not secret plans for the Croatian Danube region.

- Croatia's place is among the central European countries and those situated along the Adriatic and the Danube, said in his address to the nation on Wednesday following Croatia's official admission to the Council of Europe president Tudjman.
- As part of its plan to repatriate foreigners, Germany will be offering each person who decides to return 12,000 German marks.
- The heart of the military operation Maslenica hero transplanted into the body of a 54-year old woman.
- Trogir-built tanker named eco-tanker of the year by the U.S. magazine Maritime Reporter and Engineering News.
- Changes within the Obzor political weekly: The editor-in-chief Milan Ivkosic replaced by Branko Tudjen. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-4-4557075
